item.title: Zendaya Used This Mermaid Brush for Her Slicked Bangs Look at ‘Spider-Man’ Premiere
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our latest episode! We're talking all about the latest red carpet looks, and today, we're obsessing over Zendaya's stunning appearance at the Spider-Man: Brand New Day premiere in Los Angeles.
Zendaya, who plays MJ in the film, turned heads in a show-stopping black gown, paired with dramatic sculpted bangs. But what really caught our attention was her sleek, slicked-back hairstyle.
[Music transitions]
Host: "The mastermind behind the look is none other than celebrity hairstylist Ursula Stephen, who's worked with the likes of Rihanna and Rita Ora. And the key to achieving this sleek look? The boar bristle brush from haircare and accessories brand, Bur Bur.
Stephen used the brush on Zendaya's wet hair to section it out, adding a dab of gel for extra hold. She then blow-dried everything in place and finished it off with a hold and shine spray. The result? A sleek and dramatic look that's perfect for the red carpet.
[Music transitions]
Host: "And the best part? You can get your hands on the same brush used on Zendaya for just $72 on the Bur Bur website. The Mermaid Brush uses boar bristles and nylon pins to gently detangle hair, tame flyaways, and control frizz. Plus, it helps distribute natural oils for sleek, healthy hair.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's episode. If you want to achieve Zendaya's look, be sure to check out the Bur Bur Mermaid Brush. And don't forget to catch Spider-Man: Brand New Day in theaters on July 31st. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
